mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive in more than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases > 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows and corporate earnings are revised downwards.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO declines > 2% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent low inflation environment (CPIAUCSL growth < 1% YoY) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as real interest rates remain low.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY growth is < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% each within three months signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity accelerates.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increase > 5% within three months.

mechanism_narrative: An inversion of the yield curve (not modeled directly here but proxied by FEDFUNDS and 10-year Treasury yield spread) signals an impending recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate economic contraction.
candidate_trigger: Yield curve inversion (proxied by FEDFUNDS and 10Y spread)
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in more than 50% of instances where the yield curve inverts (proxied by FEDFUNDS and 10Y spread).
